annotations.title: Models from a country, by fashion week and season

description: Models of one nationality on Tectova's Big Four runway record, mirroring the site's three country pages. Country alone: the most cast, the last five seasons, models new to the circuit, season by season, the houses and casting directors that cast them most. Add city: that fashion week across every season since 2002. Add city and season: every model there that season, their shows, who opened or closed a show and who was new to the city. Answers questions such as "Which Chinese models walked New York Fashion Week this season?" For "this season" questions, pass city and season "ss2027" (SS27, the latest season with season pages). Without season, a city call returns that fashion week across every season since 2002, not this season.

city.description: A Big Four fashion week city. With city and no season: that nationality at that fashion week across every season since 2002. With city and season: one season's models there, their shows, who opened or closed, who was new to the city.

country.description: A country name, demonym or slug, e.g. "Brazil", "Brazilian" or "brazil", or a full tectova.com/talent/from/ URL.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous page of the same request.

season.description: With city: a season such as "SS27" or "ss2027". For "this season" questions, pass city and season "ss2027" (SS27, the latest season with season pages). Without season, a city call returns that fashion week across every season since 2002, not this season. Only seasons with a page are served.

section.description: Return one section of the page in full (paginated). Without it, the answer has the page's main list and the first rows of every other section.

name: get_country_talent
title: Models from a country, by fashion week and season
